// CASE swift_dup_plain expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async rethrows {
  for item in items {
    pair(try await step(item), try await step(item))
  }
}
// CASE swift_dup_two_strings expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async rethrows {
  for item in items {
    pair(try await step(item), "a", try await step(item), "b")
  }
}
